results.title: Sales Assistant
results.overview: On a sales day, a 28-year-old Latina migrant works at a fast fashion store in the Netherlands, surviving a job she cannot afford to lose as her body starts to resist.

results.title: Wir Sind Am Leben - Das Berlin Musical
results.original_title: Wir Sind Am Leben - Das Berlin Musical
results.overview: A new German musical by Peter Plate & Ulf Leo Sommer  After the great successes of Plate & Sommer, the author duo is back with a new Berlin musical – powerful, emotional and full of music that remains.  WE ARE ALIVE is a fast-paced, comic and deeply moving musical about departure, cohesion and joie de vivre. A night of laughing, paused – and laugh again.  A musical that you have to see in Berlin – because this city finds its voice here.

results.title: Loved By Abandoned By
results.overview: The short documentary Loved by Abandoned by portrays the life of Elikutty, an elderly woman in Velloor. For over three decades, she has scavenged for scrap to feed and protect stray dogs, forming a deep emotional bond with them. The film captures her selflessness and isolation as her canine companions mysteriously begin to disappear, exploring the profound humanity in her daily struggle.

results.title: Only the Whites of Our Eyes
results.overview: An elderly man must stay with his estranged son for a few days because of an upcoming eye surgery. Living under the same roof forces them to confront the distance between them and the grievances of their past.

results.title: Dulzaineros, el soplo de la tierra
results.original_title: Dulzaineros, el soplo de la tierra
results.overview: The last dulzaina players of Chavezpamba keep the memory of a community alive through the sounds of their dulzainas.

results.title: Praise God, The Mouse Is Dead!
results.original_title: Praise God, The Mouse Is Dead!
results.overview: The star of the 1928 film 'Steamboat Willie' turns to drugs to cope with the pressures of fame. As his life quickly spirals out of control, he becomes desperate for an escape.

results.title: COFFE
results.overview: Rendra, a migrant worker who works as a designer for a company, is enjoying his day off when he suddenly receives an urgent task from his boss. Wanting to make a cup of coffee to accompany his day off, he discovers that he has run out of coffee at home. Rendra decides to head to a cafe, but everything he does seems to go wrong, one misfortune after another, turning what was supposed to be a relaxing day off into a complete mess.

results.title: Unknown
results.overview: Unknown is about Kaik Araujo's emotional spiral. Inspired by his new book Helios Effect, the short follows his downfall and loss of self, diving into the inner workings of his mind that pushed him into an existential crisis.

results.title: Resident Birds
results.overview: After twelve years living abroad, the filmmaker returns to Ecuador and encounters six artists using their work as a trench. A real-life tragedy changes the course of the meeting, causing the line between art and activism to blur, collapse and be redefined.

results.title: Stuttgart 21 - The construction site of the century
results.overview: Germany’s most expensive major project: the new Stuttgart Central Station. For some, it is economically nonsensical and riddled with planning errors. For others, it is an impressive testament to German engineering. The only problem is: trains still aren’t running there. Why is construction taking so long? Why is Deutsche Bahn building the station at all? This documentary provides the answers. A look back at more than 30 years of Stuttgart 21.

results.title: Autopsy of the Earth
results.overview: When a 7.8-magnitude earthquake devastates Region 12, survivors in Sarangani and General Santos City confront loss, grief and broken systems - and find strength in each other

results.title: The Stray Birds
results.overview: A resilient teenage girl begins questioning the only home she has ever known. She joins forces with a young man determined to protect his younger brother, embarking on a perilous journey where courage and compassion become their only hope of finding a place to belong

results.title: The Nest Atop the Watchtower
results.original_title: Ang Pugad sa Ibabaw Kang Bantayan
results.overview: A mysterious warrior sows conflict and threatens the peace in the land. Professing their faith, displaying courage, and combining their powers, a Christian nun and Muslim young man unite to prove they are stronger than division

results.title: The Poison Seller
results.overview: Kenneth Law is accused of mailing a deadly poison worldwide leaving families demanding answers and society confronting what murder means in the internet age.

results.title: AFTER SLEEP
results.overview: Upon Selling His Parent's House, Alex Who Is An Insomniac Tries To Find A Way To Sleep Better, Only To Come Face To Face With Something Nightmarish.

results.title: La Communauté des Épinglettes
results.overview: This film is a remake of a sequence from "The Lord of The Rings : The Fellowship of the Ring", created as part of a course.

results.title: The Great Street Robbery
results.overview: it all began one helpless night when a man by the name of Andres was walking down the street when...The Great Street Robbery...

results.title: Friday Night
results.overview: Gwen goes on a date while her roommate Lucy stays in. Together with Uber driver Nick, three people look for connection on a rainy night in Baltimore.
